text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ESP32 #2 → GET /status → JSON back to the TFT (every 1 s)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • GPIO 34 and 35 are input-only on the ESP32 — they are used here for the piezo and the water probe, which is correct.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • GPIO 2 and 12 are strapping pins: keep the status LEDs on them low-current, or the board may refuse to boot.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Pump relays are active LOW — the firmware drives both HIGH on boot so nothing runs before the sequence starts.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Both boards need a common ground with the motor/pump supply; motors and pumps are NOT powered from the ESP32 3V3 rail.
